d: El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele has shared footage of his troops carrying out anti-gang operations in Haiti. Salvadoran troops have taken over Stade Sylvio Cator, Haiti's National stadium. The football stadium has been taken over by Haiti's gangs in 2024. Salvador's troops backed by the Haiti police stormed the stadium riding infantry armoured vehicles and took hold of strategic positions. El Salvador's troops also deployed gun-trotting robotic dogs that were seen patrolling dark alleys in the stadium. Bukele has announced that the stadium will now be used to launch more operations…
